justification: Woollahra DCP B3 (453 live rules) applies to 'land identified on Map 1' (p5) = the ten B1 residential precincts, but was served to every Woollahra house incl. Paddington. The five refused B1 maps were searched at the wrong scale; each map is now searched within 5% of its own printed scale bar and all ten pass the unchanged gates. B3 keyed to their union. Loaded and keyed 2026-10-21 before merge.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: The B3 rule is removed or keyed elsewhere, or the outline file lacks the union id.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Before: DQ-143 = 498 (453 of them Woollahra B3 served council-wide).
falsifiable_check.external_authority: Live after load: Vaucluse East house 452 B3 rules, Paddington HCA house 0; DQ-143 498 -> 45.

pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Per-map scale-bar search window, excluded-area cut-out, five outlines + union, B3 keying rule, one test.
